correctness.rationale: Reconstructed correspondence between vertices of KG(n,2) and auxiliary K_n edges. A forest is bipartite, hence splits into two intersecting edge families; by the star-or-triangle lemma each part is a star or a triangle. Four-cycle obstructions in the two-star/triangle cases yield |F|<=max(7,n) and equality exactly the K4+pendant C families or full-star+off-edge S families. Explicit induced-disjointness graphs are forests; intersection counts between distinct extremal families yield the claimed disjoint clique exchange components. Independent exact Python subset enumerations for n=5,6,7 found, respectively, 20,120,525 optimum families and clique-component profiles 5 K4,15 K8,35 K12 +7 K15; all best+1 subsets were checked nonforest. Original C++ verifier was inspected, not merely trusted. For n>=8, all-order classification relies on the proof.
